Unique borough-block-lot. Class A one-family homes may include attached forms. C/D rental-building candidates require 5+ dwellings and no recorded condo number. Class O offices. No condo billing lots counted as units. Stories refer to tallest building where relevant.

One account per parcel number. Detached single-family and separately classified single-family rowhouses, residential condo with nonblank unit, apartment classes starting at 5 units, office-building category. Mixed/conflicting classifications excluded.

Parcel joined by major/minor to residential, apartment-complex or commercial records. One residential improvement and one dwelling for houses and townhouse plats. Complexes require 5+ and matching use. Office group includes general, medical offices and office parks with one matching commercial record.

One account, one principal improvement. A11 houses, A12 townhouses, A13 condos with unit ID, B11 apartments with 5+ units, F10 offices with office-building or medical-office class. Only Dallas County jurisdiction. Multiple-improvement accounts excluded.

One 10-digit AIN; no duplicate eligible identifiers. SFR/house and explicit townhouse-format SFR, CND with nonblank unit, residential-income 5+ apartments, commercial offices. Condo legal class takes precedence over townhouse form. Building facts require a single improvement line.
